title: Transpose equality for the scalar quotient transition
statement: For prime l, finite extensions E and L of Q_l with embedding ι, a scheme X, finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, a complete integral E-complex K, and n ≤ m, the two morphisms obtained by (i) the level-m quotient comparison, the E normalized reduction transition, and the scalar-reduction exchange mate, and (ii) the L normalized reduction transition followed by the level-n quotient comparison, have equal images under the hom equivalence of normalizedDVRIntegralAdjunction at level m and target scalar extension.

source.place: Paragraphs 3-4, mate calculation after expanding the quotient comparison

proof.text: Apply hom-equivalence naturality to expose completion transport and reduce the statement to the residual finite reduction/tensor-square mate calculation.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs 3-4, completion naturality and residual mate calculation
